name: Are my files uploaded when adding page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Page numbering is processed entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Files never leave your device. You can verify this: open DevTools → Network tab — you should not see your PDF being uploaded during processing.

name: Can I start page numbering from a number other than 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Set any starting number in the 'Start at' field. This is useful for documents where a cover page is page 0, or for chapters that continue numbering from a previous section.

name: Can I skip the first page (cover page) when numbering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Enable the 'Skip first page' option. Page 1 (the cover) receives no number, and numbering starts from the second page.

name: Can I choose where page numbers appear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Position options include bottom center, bottom left, bottom right, top center, top left, and top right.

name: Is there a page limit for adding page numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no page or file size limits. The only practical constraint is your device's available memory.
